description: This source file defines the PersistentStateAttribute class, a custom attribute used to specify options for persistent state configuration in Orleans grain services. It includes property definitions and a constructor for setting state and storage names.

classes.name: PersistentStateAttribute
classes.description: A custom attribute class used to specify persistent state options for Orleans grain services, including the state name and storage provider name.
